# GUIDE.md - Variant 01: Software Engineer (Backend)

## Use this when applying to
Senior Software Engineer / Backend Engineer roles where Java/Spring or Python microservices, REST APIs, system design, and reliability are the core ask.

## What it foregrounds
- Backend-first: monolith-to-microservices re-architecture, REST API ownership, and reliability (self-healing retries, zero-downtime rolling updates).
- Data depth (PostgreSQL/MongoDB/SQL) given its own row right after backend.
- AI demoted to a modernization strength, present but not the identity.

## Target-JD keywords
Java, Spring Boot, Python, microservices, REST APIs, system design, PostgreSQL, SQL, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, reliability, zero-downtime deployment, scalability, backend.

## Honest fit and odds
High odds for most senior-backend JDs. Scale is described qualitatively (40+ clients) rather than at hyperscale -- fine for product companies, weaker for internet-scale infra roles. If a JD demands a stack she lacks (e.g., Go, Kafka), address it in the cover note rather than stretching the resume.

## Recommended LaTeX style: ATS (single-column)
Product-company pipelines run resumes through ATS parsers; the single-column layout maximizes parse safety. Modern is an acceptable fallback for a hand-delivered referral.

## Tweak tips
1. Mirror the JD's stack ordering in the Backend/Data rows.
2. Trim the AI row for a traditional backend shop; keep it for an AI-curious team.
3. Add honest throughput/latency numbers to the microservices bullet if the role is high-scale -- never invent metrics.

*(Fictional, anonymized sample for CI only.)*

# GUIDE.md - Variant 03: AI / GenAI Engineer

## Use this when applying to
AI / GenAI / LLM Application Engineer roles, agentic tooling, or developer-productivity AI -- not generic backend roles.

## What it foregrounds
The AI test-gen agent, the prompt toolkit, and RAG work; backend/cloud as the production-grade credibility base.

## Target-JD keywords
LLM, GenAI, RAG, prompt engineering, agents, evaluation, Python, Spring Boot, Kubernetes.

## Honest fit and odds
High and rising for AI-first scaleups. Lead with the AI test-gen result; it is the strongest, most quantified proof for this archetype.

## Recommended LaTeX style: Modern
Clean and ATS-safe; good for a differentiated but still-parseable AI resume.

## Tweak tips
1. Mirror the JD's exact AI vocabulary (RAG vs retrieval, agents vs workflows).
2. Lead with the most relevant project.
3. Trim a skills row if the 1-pager spills.

*(Fictional, anonymized sample for CI only.)*
